title: Accounts Assistant - Hybrid
description:
RG Consultancy are delighted to be working with a well-established motor trade company to help recruit an experienced Accounts Assistant. Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, this is a brilliant opportunity for anybody looking to be apart of a supportive team.

Key responsibilities :
- Support the day-to-day running of the Finance Department
- Raise and process sales invoices
- Daily bank transactions
- Process supplier payments within timely manner
- Manage supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Process purchase orders and maintaining accurate records
- Manage sales/purchase ledger department and maintain accurate supplier accounts
- Respond to all supplier and customer queries within finance
- Maintain new customer and supplier accounts.
- Assisting with payroll queries and administration
- Managing creditor accounts
- Maintain accurate financial records in line with company procedures
- Ensure company policies and procedures are followed

Benefits include:
- 37.5 hours per week with flexible start and finish times
- 25 days + bank holidays
- Company pension
- Hybrid working
- Study support for AAT or further studies
- Cycle to work
- Onsite parking

title: Administrator
company: Rise Technical Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Administrator

£27,000 - £30,000 + Training + Progression + Company Benefits

Newton-le-Willows (Commutable from: St Helens, Warrington, Haydock, Leigh, Wigan, Golborne, Ashton-in-Makerfield, Prescot, etc)

Are you an Administrator looking for a stable Monday to Friday role with a growing business that will provide full training and the opportunity to develop your skills across multiple areas of the company?

On offer is the opportunity to join a well-established organisation with an excellent reputation for looking after its staff. You'll receive ongoing support and training, allowing you to develop into a key member of a friendly and supportive administration team.

The company are looking for somebody with an administration background who is organised, eager to learn and enjoys variety in their day-to-day work. Experience within any industry will be considered, as full training will be provided.

In this role you will become part of a close-knit office team, supporting a range of departments with general administration, documentation, scheduling and customer support duties. No two days are exactly the same, making this an ideal opportunity for somebody who enjoys a varied workload.

This role would suit an Administrator looking for long-term stability, a friendly working environment and the chance to broaden their skillset within a successful business.

The Role
- General administration and office support
- Monday to Friday, office-based role
- Training across multiple areas of the business

The Person
- Administrator or Administration Assistant
- Any administration background considered
- Looking to learn new skills and develop their career

Reference Number: BBBH281699

To apply for this role or to be considered for further roles, please click "Apply Now" or contact Billy Clark at Rise Technical Recruitment.

Rise Technical Recruitment Ltd acts an employment agency for permanent roles and an employment business for temporary roles.

The salary advertised is the bracket available for this position. The actual salary paid will be dependent on your level of experience, qualifications and skill set and will be decided by our client, the employer. Rise are not responsible or liable for any hiring decisions made by the end client.

We are an equal opportunities company and welcome applications from all suitable candidates.
